name: Blue
source:
Blue is a Dragonkin, a prized companion to the Dragon Volk, who remember them once being far larger and more majestic than their current incarnation. One is gifted to the [url=/c136741]Captain[/url], who entrusts it to [url=/c136749]Noel[/url]'s care. She names it 'Blue'
